orientacion.titulo: Take control of your university finances
orientacion.descripcion: We know managing fixed and variable income while studying can be a challenge. InvertU helps you organize your budget in a simple, visual way designed for your academic life.
orientacion.imagenAlt: Books, coins and a growing plant

movimiento.descripcion: Add your allowance, your scholarship stipend or your photocopy expenses to see your monthly indicators and charts.

meta.descripcion: A new laptop, the semester or a trip? Set how much you need and track your progress with each contribution.

inicio.subtitulo: See the status of your income, expenses and savings for the selected month.
